name: Certificates and NTDS database size
description: Latest SystemData_CL certificate/NTDS inventory. Certificate expiry is shown as UTC and days remaining. MDI/Arc use source certificate array order or flattened NotAfter order, which must be verified against the collector. Missing/unparseable expiry remains unknown.
kql:
SystemData_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| extend Ldaps = todynamic(LDAPSCertificate), Certs = todynamic(Certificates), FlatDates = extract_all(@'NotAfter=([^;]+)', tostring(Certificates))
| extend LDAPSNotAfter = todatetime(Ldaps.NotAfter), MDINotAfter = coalesce(todatetime(Certs[0].NotAfter), todatetime(FlatDates[0])), ArcNotAfter = coalesce(todatetime(Certs[1].NotAfter), todatetime(FlatDates[1]))
| extend LDAPSDaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', LDAPSNotAfter, now()), MDIDaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', MDINotAfter, now()), ArcDaysRemaining = datetime_diff('day', ArcNotAfter, now())
| project Computer, Timestamp = TimeGenerated, NTDSFileSizeinGB = todouble(NTDSFileSizeinGB), LDAPSNotAfter, LDAPSDaysRemaining, LDAPSNotAfterThumbprint = tostring(Ldaps.Thumbprint), MDINotAfter, MDIDaysRemaining, ArcNotAfter, ArcDaysRemaining
| order by Computer asc
